podcast.title: Two-Man Band Precedent
podcast.body: Attila, formed in 1969 with two members, was a two-man band decades before this configuration became a common norm in music. "Two guys, a two man band decades before this became the norm."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Pre-Piano Man Career
xref.body: Billy Joel was the singer for the rock group Attila, formed in New York in 1969, years before he became known as "the piano man." "The singer's name was Billy Joel. Yeah, that Billy Joel."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
